statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Delayed NQ shows a material retreat from the overnight high without verified persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The main conditional risk window is 13:30-15:30 UTC around the cash open, Flash PMI, Barr and EIA.
headline: Low Tail, extreme Stress; the open/PMI cluster remains the narrow conditional danger window.
body: Delayed December NQ is 31,016.5 versus a 31,035.5 open and a 31,004-31,094.75 range, showing a substantial retreat from the high but no verified repeated failed-retracement sequence. VIX is near 14, while the 10Y near 4.96% and oil near $100 keep Stress elevated. Shared Finviz context is stale and partial and is excluded from current scoring.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 clock-hours, Tail was mostly low, briefly rising to 27% around the prior U.S. open before reverting below WATCH; Stress remained high to extreme.
outlookSummary: Base-case Tail stays low outside the 13:30-15:30 UTC open/PMI/Fed/EIA cluster; escalation requires observed persistent direction, shallow pullbacks, failed retracements, or a coherent second leg.

forecast.analysis: Delayed December NQ is 31,016.5 near the lower end of its 31,004-31,094.75 range after a material retreat from the high. That does not establish persistent no-retracement structure.
drivers: Delayed NQ near the range low after a material high-to-low retracement
VIX near 14; 10Y near 4.96%; oil remains near $100

news.title: European stocks gain as oil slides, AI buzz lifts tech

forecast.analysis: If European trade continues to rotate within the overnight range, Tail stays low; repeated lower lows with shallow rebounds would be the condition for escalation.
drivers: European range integrity versus shallow rebounds
Rates and oil remain cross-asset checkpoints

forecast.analysis: As U.S. premarket participation builds, Tail remains low unless directional efficiency rises and counter-moves become consistently shallow.
drivers: Retracement depth before the cash session

forecast.analysis: With the cash open and Flash PMI approaching, Stress rises sharply. Tail reaches WATCH only if pre-open trade holds an extreme with weak counter-moves.
drivers: Cash open and Flash PMI proximity
Pre-open extreme holding versus two-way rotation

forecast.analysis: The 13:30 cash open and 13:45 Flash PMI form the peak checkpoint. Elevated Tail is conditional on persistent direction, failed retracements, or repeated extension.
drivers: Failed retracements are the key Tail checkpoint

forecast.analysis: Post-PMI discovery overlaps Barr at 14:05 and EIA at 14:30. Elevated Tail requires a coherent second leg or continued mean-reversion failure.
drivers: Barr remarks and EIA as additional volatility checkpoints

forecast.analysis: If two-way price discovery returns after the data and speeches, Tail falls to WATCH; a delayed second leg or repeated extension would keep risk elevated.
drivers: Two-way discovery versus delayed second leg

forecast.analysis: If the initial U.S. move develops meaningful retracements, event pressure should fade; continued repeated extension would prolong WATCH conditions.
Mid-afternoon Tail sits at WATCH only if the earlier directional move still resists meaningful retracement; stabilization would keep the path recoverable.
Absent a fresh catalyst, Tail returns low if earlier direction has already produced normal retracement depth and no new extension sequence develops.
drivers: Normal retracement depth versus renewed extension

forecast.analysis: Power-hour participation can revive path risk; WATCH is conditional on renewed directional efficiency with weak pullbacks into the cash close.
After the cash close, Tail drops low if the session ends with two-way structure rather than a persistent extreme hold or unresolved second leg.
drivers: Resolution of any late-session directional leg

forecast.analysis: If after-hours trade stays balanced and no new geopolitical or policy catalyst emerges, Tail remains low while Stress gradually recedes.
Low-liquidity evening trade keeps Tail low unless a fresh catalyst creates sustained extension without meaningful counter-moves.
The base case remains low Tail in quiet evening trade; a durable one-way break would require fresh evidence rather than carryover from the U.S. session.
drivers: Need for fresh evidence of persistent extension

forecast.analysis: If early Asia opens without a directional shock, Tail stays low and Stress eases as the U.S. event cluster moves into the past.
Tail remains low if Asia shows ordinary two-way rotation; repeated extension after failed pullbacks would invalidate that base case.
drivers: Repeated extension as the invalidation condition

forecast.analysis: The overnight base case stays low Tail if price discovery remains two-way and cross-assets do not align into a fresh directional impulse.
Low Tail persists conditionally through the thin overnight window; only sustained directional efficiency would justify escalation.
Ahead of Europe, Tail remains low if the overnight range holds and no new geopolitical discontinuity appears.
European pre-open participation can widen ranges; Tail stays low unless the transition produces repeated extension and shallow counter-moves.
If Europe opens with balanced breadth and normal pullbacks, Tail remains low; a clean one-way break would raise the next-session risk assessment.
European morning activity lifts Stress modestly, while Tail remains low unless directional efficiency becomes persistent across multiple observations.
As the next U.S. premarket approaches, Stress returns to extreme territory; Tail remains low unless a fresh one-way structure is actually observed.
drivers: Fresh one-way structure required for Tail escalation

forecastDetail.comment: Delayed NQ has retreated materially from its overnight high; current evidence does not establish persistent mean-reversion failure.
European rotation keeps Tail low unless repeated lower lows combine with shallow rebounds.
Premarket Tail stays low unless directional efficiency rises and counter-moves contract.
WATCH reflects the approaching cash-open/PMI cluster and requires pre-open extreme holding or weak counter-moves.
Elevated Tail is conditional on persistent cash-open/PMI direction with failed retracements or repeated extension.
Post-PMI/Barr/EIA Tail stays elevated only if a coherent second leg or continued mean-reversion failure develops.
